    • worldRadius

      public volatile double worldRadius
      Approximate icon radius in world units.

      Set by the view after construction and again whenever the viewport zoom or size changes. The simulation reads this field on the simulation thread to compute overlap-aware repulsion and to clamp positions so icons remain fully visible inside the unit square.

      Declared volatile because the view writes it on the EDT while the simulation thread reads it concurrently. A stale value following a just-completed zoom is harmless — it affects at most one simulation step — but the volatile guarantee ensures the simulation thread will see the updated value on the immediately following read without requiring an explicit lock or memory barrier.
